title: Type 2 diabetes curated effector gene predictions (Mahajan A and McCarthy MI 2019)
bodyHtml:
The curated T2D effector gene predictions from Anubha Mahajan and Mark McCarthy (Unpublished, 2019) synthesize multiple kinds of biological evidence to classify the potential of genes to be causal for T2D. Click the Research Method tab for more details.

The T2D effector prediction summary page compares these results with type 2 diabetes effector gene predictions generated by two other methods.
